apiKey.confirmBody: This will create a new key and immediately invalidate the old one. Any scripts or integrations using the current key will stop working.
apiKey.description: Required for external API access (scripts, nzb360, etc.). The web UI does not need it.
apiKey.regenerateHint: Regenerating the key will invalidate the current one immediately.
apiKey.unavailableBody: This install has not issued an API key. External access stays disabled until one exists.
apiKey.usageBody: Include the key in the <1>X-Api-Key</1> header when making API requests from external tools, scripts, or apps like nzb360.

diskPressure.description: Reclaim the lowest-value content only when space runs low
diskPressure.observeHint: Logs and notifies what it would reclaim — nothing is deleted.

librarySync.description: Automatically pull new movies and shows from {{name}} into Prunerr
librarySync.enableHint: Refresh the library so new items appear without clicking “Sync Library”
librarySync.title: {{name}} library sync

scan.autoProcessHint: Delete queued items once the grace period expires
scan.enableHint: Evaluate the library against your rules on a schedule

backup.confirmImportBody: Importing will overwrite all current settings with the values from {{filename}}. This action cannot be undone.
backup.confirmRestoreBody: Everything currently in Prunerr — library, rules, queue and history — will be replaced by {{filename}}.
backup.confirmRestoreSafety: Your current database is saved alongside it first, so a mistake can be undone from the data folder.
backup.description: Export settings for backup or import from a previous export
backup.exportHint: Exports include all settings including service credentials. Keep the file secure.
backup.fullHint: The entire database — library, rules, queue, history and settings. Restoring replaces everything currently in Prunerr.
backup.importSuccess: Settings imported successfully! The page will reload with new values.
backup.restoreDoneHint: Reload the page to see the restored data.

firstRun.body: Connect {{name}} and Prunerr can read your library. Add Sonarr or Radarr when you want it to actually delete things — scanning stays off until then.
firstRun.title: Nothing is connected yet

sections.overseerrDescription: Clears the request when Prunerr deletes what it asked for
sections.sonarrRadarrDescription: Prunerr deletes through these — without them it can only report
sections.unraidDescription: Array and disk monitoring — feeds the disk-pressure gauge

connections.testAllEmpty: Nothing is configured to test yet

watchHistory.freshHint: Optional — pick one to unlock watch-count rules
watchHistory.hint: Play counts and watched status · {{days}} day lookback
watchHistory.mismatch: {{provider}} only resolves Plex item ids, so on {{name}} every item reports zero plays — and zero-play items are exactly what the rules engine deletes. Switch to “{{name}} direct”.
watchHistory.plexOnly: {{provider}} reads Plex item ids, so it needs a Plex media server.
watchHistory.saveFailed: Could not save the watch history provider
watchHistory.title: Watch history provider

criticalAuto.description: Bypasses the grace period when critically low. Protected items are always skipped.
criticalAuto.title: Auto-delete immediately on critical pressure

enable.description: Monitors real free space and acts only when below your target

target.criticalThreshold: critical threshold ({{unit}}) — below this, reclaim with no grace
target.title: Keep free

display.description: Customize how dates, times, and sizes are shown

exclusionPatterns.activeCount_one: {{count}} active pattern. Items matching any pattern will be skipped during rule evaluation.
exclusionPatterns.activeCount_other: {{count}} active pattern. Items matching any pattern will be skipped during rule evaluation.
exclusionPatterns.description: Items matching these patterns will be automatically protected from deletion during scans
exclusionPatterns.emptyBody: Add one to permanently shield titles — e.g. anything containing “Christmas”.
exclusionPatterns.hitsUnknown: Match count is calculated on the next scan
exclusionPatterns.title: Exclusion Patterns

automation.body: You can set schedules now — they stay dormant until {{name}} is connected.
automation.noPaths: No monitored paths yet — add one to watch free space
automation.title: Waiting on a {{name}} connection

footnote.staged: Edits are staged locally — nothing is written until you save.

haptics.description: Vibration on touch interactions — supported mobile devices only
haptics.enableDescription: A subtle tap when opening, closing, and dismissing sheets. Saved per device.

libraryExclusions.empty: No libraries found. Make sure {{server}} is configured and connected.
libraryExclusions.emptyFresh: Connect {{server}} and your libraries will appear here — everything is included by default.
libraryExclusions.title: Library Exclusions

mediaServer.description: The server Prunerr reads your library from
mediaServer.playbackReportingHint: Tip: install the Playback Reporting plugin on your server. Without it only the most recent play of each item is recorded, so repeat views are missed and play counts read low.
mediaServer.title: Media Server

discord.description: Send notifications to a Discord channel
discord.title: Discord Webhook

plexSync.hourlyHint: Sync will run at this minute past each hour
plexSync.timeHint: Run before your scan so rules see the latest catalog

privacy.announcementsBody: The same switch controls the announcements shown under What’s new in the sidebar. They are fetched from the same endpoint a few times a day with only the version number attached; with this off, none are shown.
privacy.description: What Prunerr sends outside your network, and how to stop it.
privacy.installCountBody: Once a day, Prunerr sends a random ID and its version number so we can see how many installs are out there. Nothing about your library, your settings, your credentials or you is included, and your IP address is not stored. Switching this off deletes the random ID.
privacy.lockedByEnv: Turned off for this container by TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false. Nothing is sent, and this switch cannot override it.
privacy.noEndpoint: This build has no telemetry endpoint configured, so nothing is sent regardless of this switch.

protectedNow.caption: Titles your current rules will not touch
protectedNow.title: Protected right now

schedule.hourlyHint: Scan will run at this minute past each hour
schedule.timeHint: Scan will run at this time
schedule.title: Scan Schedule

lookback.description: How far back to fetch watch history data

watchHistory.mediaServerDirectInfo: No extra configuration needed — Prunerr will read history from your media server using the connection set in the Media Server section above. Install the Playback Reporting plugin for full play-count accuracy.
watchHistory.plexDirectInfo: No extra configuration needed — Prunerr will read history from your Plex server using the connection set in the Media Server section above. Requires the server-owner's token.
